newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends up, export data little impact.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends up, export data little impact.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended higher on light buying, with the December 1-25 export having little impact on the market. There was some support but dealing was slow after the Christmas break. Players were still away for end-year holidays.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Also saw scattered interest, with players slowing down their year-end business.
"Most people were still away for the year-end holidays." Price movements were limited on lack of interest after the Christmas holiday break.
Futures prices were traded within a seven-ringgit range, with third month, March futures closing seven ringgit up at 1,236 ringgit ($488.92) a tonne.
Traders expected the market to lock in a tight range until after the New Year holidays.
Turnover on the futures market was 554 lots.

Among physical, Dec (south) saw offers at 1,260 ringgit against bids at 1,255. Dec (north) was offered at 1,250 and bids at 1,240. Jan (south) saw offers at 1,260 with bids at 1,255, Jan (central) at 1,250 with bids at 1,240.
Feb (south) was offered at 1,260 and bids at 1,255.
Among refined products, Jan RBD palm oil was offered at $530 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Feb/March at $527.50 and Apr/May/Jun at $527.50.
Jan RBD palm olein saw offers at $567.50, Feb at $565, March at $562.50 and Apr/May/June at $555.
Jan RBD palm stearin was offered at $402.50, Feb/Mar at $405, and Jan/Feb palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $292.50. -- Tan Lee Lee - (603-230-7510) ($1 =2.5280 ringgit)
